episodes.title: Magic Hour
episodes.summary: Young reporter Hilde Lisko and her family are settling into their new life in a small town—until a shocking event changes everything.

episodes.title: Never Be the Same
episodes.summary: Hilde learns more about Erie Harbor's secrets. Her father, Matt, is forced to face his past and reconnect with his own father.

episodes.title: Sting Like a Bee
episodes.summary: Chasing down a dangerous lead brings Hilde face-to-face with a potential suspect. Matt's run-in with an old friend spirals out of control.

episodes.title: The Bird, Man
episodes.summary: Hilde, Donny, and Spoon track down Birdman, a mysterious outcast who may have crucial information about the Richie Fife case.

episodes.title: The Green Bike
episodes.summary: Convinced that the wrong person was convicted in the Richie Fife case 30 years ago, Hilde sets out to prove it.

episodes.title: 88 Miles an Hour
episodes.summary: As the '80s dance looms, Hilde and Matt find a promising new lead in the investigation. Frank breaks rank to get to the root of the case.

episodes.title: Search Party
episodes.summary: When Hilde goes missing, Matt is forced to confront his worst nightmare.

episodes.title: The Future is Female
episodes.summary: Hilde creates a movement to root out corruption in Erie Harbor. Matt and Bridget try to mend their relationship.

episodes.title: Superhero Monster Slayer
episodes.summary: A break in the Richie Fife case results in a surprise arrest. Matt and Hilde take a road trip to learn more about the suspect.

episodes.title: Bigger Than All of Us
episodes.summary: Significant new evidence is dredged up from a nearby lake. Hilde discovers that it's the beginning of a much larger mystery.

episodes.title: Not Giving Up
episodes.summary: Hilde struggles to let the mystery of Richie Fife go, even as a mysterious explosion leads her to new secrets buried in Erie Harbor's past.

episodes.title: I Believe You
episodes.summary: A blackout complicates Hilde's investigation. Matt and Bridget discover that Wott Management is not what it seems.

episodes.title: Fighting His Ghost
episodes.summary: Hilde follows a lead in hopes of saving her grandfather. Matt and Bridget struggle with parenting a newly rebellious Izzy.

episodes.title: Dark Rooms
episodes.summary: Following the money, Hilde is drawn to the most powerful company in Erie Harbor. Someone unexpected comes back into Izzy's life.

episodes.title: The Black Box
episodes.summary: The contents of the black box shock Hilde. Matt realizes how much he never knew about his father.

episodes.title: What's Out There
episodes.summary: When they venture to a remote island, Hilde and Matt make a troubling discovery in the surrounding lake.

episodes.title: Just a Bird
episodes.summary: Hilde and her friends face the consequences of their actions. The Liskos try to help Sylvester jog his memory.

episodes.title: The Bad Guy
episodes.summary: As Hilde tries to make amends with Donny and Spoon, Grant closes in. Spirit Week brings up old fears for Izzy.

episodes.title: The Biggest Life
episodes.summary: Tragedy strikes the Lisko family. Hilde loses her paper. Izzy takes a stand.

episodes.title: The Smoking Gun
episodes.summary: Matt and Hilde finally get answers. The Liskos struggle to convince the town to join their fight.
